Dansk Radiologisk Selskab (the Danish Radiological Society) is a professional medical organization in Denmark. Within the provided corpus, the entity is mentioned only once, in the context of the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (AKDB) report evaluating clinical indicators for patients with acute abdominal pain [^src1]. 

The society was contacted to provide an official position on the use of contrast-enhanced CT scans for these patients [^src1]. This consultation is directly relevant to the evidence base and implementation of [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], a clinical metric that tracks early CT scanning in acute surgical settings to improve diagnostic certainty and reduce mortality [^src1]. 

Because the source document only notes that the society was asked for its position, no further details regarding their specific response, additional factual claims, or a timeline of events are available in the current dataset.
